summary: Provenance-backed, privacy-safe, version-aware model and searchable source corpus for roughly 20 years of RTEC HR process documentation.
current_priorities: Continue ingesting the historical RTEC HR document base in small committed batches.
Find later AAP/EEO plans so the June 30, 2022 AAP package can be linked into a supersession/version chain.
Validate percentage/formula anomalies before reusing 2022 AAP calculations in any later plan.
Use later and more authoritative sources to resolve the currentness/gap queue and build supersession chains.
Preserve safe manuals, policies, procedures, templates, training/reference sources, and organizational materials in full searchable form.
Keep live employee/applicant/medical/incident/EEO roster content out of GitHub while retaining privacy-safe provenance and aggregate evidence.
constraints: GitHub stores derived sanitized process knowledge, not live employee/applicant records or raw OCR.
Do not generalize employee-specific case facts into global process rules.
Uncertain claims remain candidates until corroborated or user-confirmed.
Preserve source provenance and document-version context for every promoted rule.
HR-GUI PROJECT_GUIDE.md privacy rules remain authoritative for scanner development.
Do not assume an older source is current; determine effective period and supersession before relying on it operationally.

corpus_scope.temporal_assumption: Historical by default until effective period/currentness is established.
corpus_scope.preservation_rule: Retain obsolete and superseded process sources for chronology and legacy-reference purposes.

reference_form_context.full_source_rule: When a safe original reference artifact is available, preserve it in full or by a lossless repository-safe representation and link it to the existing catalog entry.
reference_form_context.authority_rule: Form presence is contextual evidence, not automatic current policy authority.
